# Verify the business identity for QuickBooks Online Payroll, QuickBooks Desktop Payroll, QuickBooks Payments, and QuickBooks Bill Pay

by Intuit • ![Image Alt Text](https://quickbooks.intuit.com/oidam/intuit/gbsg/en_us/product-expression/Support%20site%20assets/thumbs-up.svg) 191  •

![Image Alt Text](https://quickbooks.intuit.com/oidam/intuit/gbsg/en_us/product-expression/Support%20site%20assets/time-clock.svg) Updated 10/26/2026 16:34

Payroll is where you manage contractors and employees, track employee benefits, and stay in compliance with tax and legal requirements. If you want QuickBooks to calculate payroll for you, sign up for [Intuit QuickBooks Workforce](https://quickbooks.intuit.com/payroll//?cid=CSSDR224-SUP-US-QBOPR-CORE-NA-XSLL-REC-NA-FY26-IARec-UKN-Redesign-Payroll5).

Learn how to verify your principal officer and business identity so you can process payments or use our payroll services with QuickBooks.

When you sign up for Intuit QuickBooks Workforce or QuickBooks Desktop Payroll, QuickBooks Payments, or QuickBooks Bill Pay, sometimes we need to reach out to verify some more of your info.

Federal regulations require us to verify the identity of the principal officer and the business when you use our payments and payroll services. See our merchant agreements for [Payments](https://quickbooks.intuit.com/payments/legal/TOC102017/merchant-agreement/) and [Payroll](https://quickbooks.intuit.com/software-licenses/qb2020_and_intuit_payroll_services_eula/) for more details.

Here are some answers to common questions about how to finish your verification so you can continue to use our payments or payroll services.

## How we'll contact you to verify your info

When you set up your new QuickBooks Payments, QuickBooks Bill Pay, or Intuit QuickBooks Workforce, we need to verify the principal officer and business info you entered. If we can't, we’ll request additional info by phone or email request.

## Actions you'll need to do

**Respond to the email message**

1. Review the email message you receive from **qbo@intuit.com** or **AccountValidation@intuit.com**.

2. Gather the documents we request. If you have paper copies, you can take photos of them with your phone. Make sure they're high-quality and clear enough to read.

3. Before the deadline, follow the instructions in the email message to upload or send your documents.


**Add information to an open case**

You can also provide information and documents directly in your product.

1. Sign in to your account.

2. Select **Settings**, then **Resolution Center**.

3. Find your open case, then select it.

4. If there are documents requested, select the info request box.

5. Select **+Add document**, attach the file, then select **Open**. Repeat this step if we're requesting multiple documents.



   - **Important**: We won't review your case until all info and documents are provided.
6. If there are additional questions, enter your response in the text field.

7. Once you're done, the status will change to **In Review**.


Once we receive your documents, we'll review your case within 2 business days. We’ll send you an email as soon as it’s complete.

In the meantime, you can continue to process payments and use our payroll services.

|     |
| --- |
| **Important**: Make sure you respond by the deadline in your email to avoid interruption or termination of your payments or payroll service. |

## If you don’t respond by the deadline

### QuickBooks Payments

After the deadline, we'll cancel your service. You’ll have to [sign up for QuickBooks Payments](https://community.intuit.com/oicms/L2z9w99KD_US_en_US) again.

### QuickBooks Bill Pay

After the deadline, we'll cancel your service. You’ll have to [sign up for QuickBooks Bill Pay](https://community.intuit.com/oicms/L8p08lKIW_US_en_US) again.

### Intuit QuickBooks Workforce or QuickBooks Desktop Payroll

After the deadline, you can't use direct deposit and tax payment services. You can pay employees with paper checks and make any tax payments on your own.

To use direct deposit and tax payment services again, [contact us](https://community.intuit.com/oicms/L7lDnkKLB_US_en_US).

## If you don’t provide the documents we request

### QuickBooks Payments

We'll close your QuickBooks Payments account the date we list on the first email you get.

### QuickBooks Bill Pay

We'll close your QuickBooks Bill Pay account the date we list on the first email you get.

### Intuit QuickBooks Workforce or QuickBooks Desktop Payroll

Your Intuit QuickBooks Workforce or QuickBooks Desktop Payroll account will stay open. We'll disable your direct deposit and tax payment services. You can pay your employees with paper checks and make tax payments on your own.

## Use QuickBooks Payments, QuickBooks Bill Pay, or Intuit QuickBooks Workforce services

Now that your verification is complete, learn how to use QuickBooks Payments, QuickBooks Bill Pay, or Intuit QuickBooks Workforce.

## Frequently asked questions

#### Can I reopen a closed case in the Resolution Center?

Yes, you can reopen a closed case to provide additional information.

1. Sign in to your account.

2. Select **Settings**, then **Resolution center**.

3. Go to **Closed cases**, find the case you want to reopen, then select **Reopen**.

4. In the box that appears, enter why you're reopening the case.

5. Select **Submit**.

6. Your case is reopened and an expert will be notified. You can still add more information using **Add information** or **Share an update**.
